name: bedrock
description: A semantic normalizer for JavaScript and TypeScript — one canonical way to write any computation.

scripts.build: bun build src/cli/index.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --target bun && echo '#!/usr/bin/env bun' | cat - dist/cli.js > dist/cli.tmp.js && mv dist/cli.tmp.js dist/cli.js && chmod +x dist/cli.js
